# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_RIBBON_COMPRESSION_MEANREV

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates significantly from VWAP while the EMA ribbon (EMA8-EMA21) is compressed (indicating low momentum and equilibrium), the move is likely exhausted and will revert to VWAP. This captures mean-reversion opportunities in low-VOL environments where extended deviations from VWAP are unsustainable without ribbon expansion.

## Mechanism

Calculate ribbon width = |EMA8 - EMA21|. If ribbon width < 0.05×price (compression) AND price deviates > 1.0×ATR(14) above VWAP, enter short at bar close. If price deviates > 1.0×ATR below VWAP under same compression, enter long at bar close. Exit: stop = recent extreme (bar high for shorts, bar low for longs); target = VWAP re-entry or 0.5×ATR if VWAP not reached within 3 bars. Optional premium-stop (e.g., stop 0.25% away) to avoid premature exits. Avoid high-VIX (>25) where trends persist despite ribbon compression.
